description: This file sets up and runs an AI-powered conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model services, with transport configurations and event handlers.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context messages for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and timeout.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the AI bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and starts the bot.
